name: @w6w-apps/google-admin
description: Manage Google Workspace users, groups and organizational units via the Admin SDK Directory API.

w6w.longDescription:
Google Workspace Admin provisions and manages a Workspace domain's directory from a workflow — creating, updating and deleting users; creating, updating and deleting groups and their memberships; and organizing users into organizational units.

Every operation requires either a Google Workspace super admin's OAuth consent, or a service account authorized for Domain-Wide Delegation and impersonating an admin user — the Admin SDK Directory API has no lower-privilege mode. Group membership is managed as a first-class concern: members can be added, removed and listed independently of editing the group itself, which matters for workflows that sync membership from an external source of truth (an HR system, a ticket) rather than managing groups by hand.

A fit for automating employee onboarding/offboarding (create the account, add it to the right groups, place it in the right org unit) or keeping group rosters in sync with an external roster.
